name: Electrophysiology during auditory tasks in rats (Brody Lab)
description: Wrote conversion code for three of the lab's recording systems in rats: Neuropixels recordings during the Poisson Clicks task, Neuralynx tetrode recordings, and wireless SpikeGadgets tetrode recordings, each with the trials of its task and the latter two with their sorted units.
Built SpikeInterface pipelines to sort each kind of recording, including a grid search over the sorter's parameters.
